text:
rachel: Noticed weird quota spikes in the dashboard for a few routes. Many rows show project=null but service_account present. Quotas are charged to projects so this looks wrong.

tom: I can reproduce on staging. The auth proxy path that handles delegated exchanges strips x-project when it falls back to token introspection.

kai: That sounds like the fallback code path we added to avoid OIDC calls under heavy load. We set a cheap introspect that only returns sa_id and scopes.

infra-bot: deploy: auth-proxy v2.4.0 -> canary at 2024-06-12T12:01:00Z :white_check_mark:

nina: If the project claim is missing, our quota router currently attributes to org (if present) otherwise 'unknown' which causes unfair billing. We should prefer service-account->project lookup before marking unknown.

ops: Changing attribution order is safe, but we need to ensure we have a stable mapping from SA -> project for all tenants. That mapping comes from the identity service which is eventually consistent.

pat: Suggestion: add a lightweight SA->project hint in the auth proxy cache (ttl 5m) and emit a minimal attribution tag in telemetry so console can reconcile without full enrichment. Small payload e.g., `{had_project_hint:true}`.

rachel: I like that. It avoids rehydrating the identity service in the hot path. Does it cover edgecases where SA belongs to multiple projects?

tom: In our world, SA is bound to a single project id. Multi-binding isn't supported currently. If it ever is, we'd set hint to ambiguous.

kai: We should also expose an "attribution_confidence" enum in telemetry (HIGH/MED/LOW). HIGH = project claim present, MED = SA->project hint, LOW = org-only or unknown. Console can use this to show when quota numbers may shift.

console-bot: new feature request created: CONSOLE-1402 "show attribution confidence + hint tooltip"

ops: Cost note: emitting the hint increases event size ~9 bytes per event. For 1B events/month that's ~9GB compressed; acceptable but include a toggle.

nina: Rollout plan proposal: 1) Add SA->project hint + confidence enum to telemetry (default off) 2) Internal enable for infra+beta orgs 3) Turn on for top 20 customers for 2 weeks to validate 4) Public opt-in toggle in console 5) Gradual default enable after 60 days if stable.

pat: Add a circuit-breaker: if ingestion or storage delta >1.8x in 24h, auto-disable hints and alert SRE.

rachel: Owners: Rachel (product), Tom (auth-proxy implementation), Kai (telemetry schema), Nina (console UX), Ops (cost & SRE runbook).

tom: I'll drop a PR with the SA hint and confidence field. Quick example record:```json
{
  "request_id": "req-abc123",
  "service_account": "sa-77-prod",
  "project": null,
  "had_project_hint": true,
  "attribution_confidence": "MED"
}
```

pat: We'll need a migration plan for historical dashboards. Console should surface a banner: "Attribution method changed; numbers may differ" when users opt-in.

nina: I'll prototype the banner copy and the confidence badge UI (green/yellow/red).

ops: Schedule a quick runbook review with SRE before canary. Also include a metric for last-successful-enrichment-timestamp per route.

rachel: Great. Sync tomorrow 11am PT to review PR and UI mock. Thanks all.

infra-bot: ticket created: INFRA-3022 "auth: SA->project hint + attribution_confidence telemetry"

console-bot: linked CONSOLE-1402 -> INFRA-3022

rachel: Closing thread; follow tickets for details.
